resources.string: Sabbaq reads the offers shown in supported ride apps only and taps accept on the offer that matches your conditions, after you turn it on. It does nothing without a valid subscription, and you can stop it from the app or the notification at any time.
You set your conditions once, and Sabbaq watches the offers and accepts the ones that match.
